boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Kansas State University
boards.description: Ten currently listed, under-21-safe food stops in Manhattan with late operating hours verified from direct business or district sources.

cards.title: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill
cards.subtitle: 325 East Poyntz Ave, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the Poyntz Avenue location for a late meal; check the official ordering page before leaving because daily hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A Poyntz Avenue restaurant listed through midnight most nights and until 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Manhattan location lists hours of 11 AM–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11 AM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill — Manhattan, KS
cards.access_notes: Official listed hours: Sun–Thu 11 AM–12 AM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–2 AM. Confirm holiday hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fat Shack
cards.subtitle: 1131 Moro St, Manhattan
cards.notes: Head to the Moro Street storefront when you need a food option after most evening service ends; confirm service availability first.
cards.short_summary: A Moro Street sandwich-and-dessert stop with listed service to 1 AM or 3 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack’s Manhattan menu lists 1131 Moro St and hours of 11 AM–1 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 11 AM–3 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fat Shack Manhattan Menu
cards.access_notes: Official menu lists Sun–Wed 11 AM–1 AM and Thu–Sat 11 AM–3 AM. Check for changes before going.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: 1120b Moro Street, Manhattan
cards.notes: Choose this Moro Street calzone shop for a very late carryout or delivery option; verify the day’s operations before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A calzone restaurant in Aggieville with a listed 4 AM close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aggieville district listing gives D.P. Dough’s address as 1120b Moro Street and lists hours of 4 PM–4 AM Monday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Aggieville — D.P. Dough
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 4 PM–4 AM daily. Verify hours and ordering availability before heading out.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Westport Road
cards.subtitle: 1155 Westport Road, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the latest listed access; dine-in closes earlier, so plan for takeout when arriving later in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A Westport Road drive-through that the official locator lists until 2 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through hours of 7 AM–2 AM every day at 1155 Westport Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1155 Westport Road, Manhattan
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed 7 AM–2 AM daily; official page lists Thursday dine-in only through 10 PM. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on East Poyntz
cards.subtitle: 329 East Poyntz Ave, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the East Poyntz dining room or drive-through for a later food stop; check current service before starting the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Poyntz Avenue chicken-finger restaurant listed until midnight or 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists both dine-in and drive-through at 329 East Poyntz Ave until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — 329 East Poyntz Ave
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sun–Thu 10 AM–12 AM; Fri–Sat 10 AM–2 AM for dine-in and drive-through. Verify exceptions.

cards.title: Papa Johns on Anderson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2615 Anderson Avenue, Manhattan
cards.notes: Order ahead for carryout or delivery from Anderson Avenue; the official page separates delivery and carryout closing times.
cards.short_summary: An Anderson Avenue pizza location with midnight service most days and later Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday; carryout is listed until 11:40 PM or 12:40 AM.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns — 2615 Anderson Avenue, Manhattan
cards.access_notes: Delivery: midnight Sun–Thu, 1 AM Fri–Sat; carryout: 11:40 PM Sun–Thu, 12:40 AM Fri–Sat. Confirm availability.

cards.title: Culver's on McCall Road
cards.subtitle: 529 McCall Rd, Manhattan
cards.notes: Make this a late-evening stop for dine-in or drive-through; the official restaurant page lists the same midnight close every day.
cards.short_summary: A McCall Road restaurant listed open to midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s official Manhattan location lists lobby, dine-in, and drive-through hours of 10 AM–midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Culver's — Manhattan, KS, McCall Rd
cards.access_notes: Lobby, dine-in, and drive-through are listed 10 AM–12 AM daily; Curdside ends at 11:45 PM. Check updates before visiting.

cards.title: Wendy's on Good Food Place
cards.subtitle: 100 Good Food Place, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-through for a later takeout stop; official hours list midnight daily but note that holidays may vary.
cards.short_summary: A Good Food Place restaurant and drive-through listed through midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 7:30 AM–midnight Monday through Sunday at 100 Good Food Place.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 100 Good Food Place, Manhattan
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are listed 7:30 AM–12 AM daily; the official page notes holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Anderson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2707 Anderson Ave, Manhattan
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order before heading over; the official locator lists both store and delivery service through 11 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: An Anderson Avenue sandwich shop with official hours to 11 PM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s official page lists the 2707 Anderson Ave location and its delivery hours as 10 AM–11 PM every day.
cards.source_title: Jimmy John's — 2707 Anderson Ave, Manhattan
cards.access_notes: Store and delivery hours are listed 10 AM–11 PM daily. Verify delivery-area eligibility and current hours before ordering.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Hostetler Drive
cards.subtitle: 1005 Hostetler Drive, Manhattan
cards.notes: Plan carryout or delivery from Hostetler Drive for a later pizza option, especially on Friday or Saturday when the official page lists midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Hostetler Drive pizza restaurant listed through midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout hours at 1005 Hostetler Drive until midnight on Friday and Saturday and until 11 PM other days.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 1005 Hostetler Drive, Manhattan
cards.access_notes: Official listed delivery and carryout hours: 10:30 AM–11 PM Sun–Thu; through 12 AM Fri–Sat. Confirm before visiting.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten free, under-21-safe places and activities at or near K-State with direct evidence of no required admission or purchase.

cards.title: Walk the K-State Gardens
cards.subtitle: 1712 Claflin Dr., K-State campus
cards.notes: Meet at the garden entrance, take a slow loop through the planted areas, and use the benches for an unhurried outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A free dawn-to-dusk garden walk with room to talk.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State states that the Gardens and adjacent parking are free and open to the public from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Kansas State University Gardens
cards.access_notes: Free public access from dawn to dusk; follow posted parking-registration information.

cards.title: Browse the Cottage Garden
cards.subtitle: Kansas State University Gardens
cards.notes: Start near the Quinlan Visitor Center, identify a few plants together, and make this compact garden section a low-key walk-and-talk stop.
cards.short_summary: An English-country-style garden within K-State’s free public gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Extension identifies the Cottage Garden at K-State Gardens and states the Gardens are open to the public year-round with free admission and parking.
cards.source_title: Water & Whimsy | K-State Research and Extension, Riley County
cards.access_notes: Located inside the K-State Gardens; use during the Gardens’ public-access period and observe posted site guidance.

cards.title: Pause at the Butterfly Garden
cards.subtitle: Kansas State University Gardens
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a quiet outdoor reset, look for pollinators from the paths, and leave plants and insects undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A pollinator-focused garden stop inside K-State’s free public gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Extension identifies the Butterfly Garden at K-State Gardens and states the Gardens are open to the public year-round with free admission and parking.
cards.source_title: Water & Whimsy | K-State Research and Extension, Riley County
cards.access_notes: Located inside the K-State Gardens; stay on paths and do not collect plants or insects.

cards.title: Stroll the Conservatory Garden
cards.subtitle: Kansas State University Gardens
cards.notes: Use the perennial collections as prompts for a photo walk, then regroup at a bench before continuing through the larger garden grounds.
cards.short_summary: Seasonal perennial collections in K-State’s free-access garden grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Extension identifies the Conservatory Garden at K-State Gardens and states the Gardens are open to the public year-round with free admission and parking.
cards.source_title: Water & Whimsy | K-State Research and Extension, Riley County
cards.access_notes: Located inside the K-State Gardens; visit during public-access hours and follow any seasonal restrictions.

cards.title: See “Rural America”
cards.subtitle: Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.notes: Meet in the galleries, choose one work each to discuss, and compare what you notice before moving on to the collection displays.
cards.short_summary: A current Beach Museum exhibition for a free art-centered conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach Museum lists “Rural America” among its current exhibitions and states that museum admission and parking are always free.
cards.source_title: Beach Update | Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Museum hours listed by K-State: Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 10–5; Thursday 10–8; Saturday 11–4.

cards.entity_name: STE[A]M: Exploring Science and Math through Art
cards.title: Explore STE[A]M Through Art
cards.subtitle: Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.notes: Walk the exhibition together and trade observations about where science, math, materials, and visual design overlap in the displayed work.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery activity built around art, science, and math connections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach Museum lists “STE[A]M: Exploring Science and Math through Art” as ongoing and states that museum admission and parking are always free.
cards.source_title: Beach Update | Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Museum hours listed by K-State: Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 10–5; Thursday 10–8; Saturday 11–4.

cards.title: Look Around the Hempler Gallery
cards.subtitle: Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.notes: Use the gallery as a shared looking exercise: pick a work about place or landscape, then compare details each person noticed.
cards.short_summary: One of Beach Museum’s named collection galleries, with free museum admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach Museum identifies the Orval Hempler Gallery as a collection gallery and states admission and parking are always free.
cards.source_title: Beach Update | Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Located at the Beach Museum, 701 Beach Lane; personal non-flash photography is permitted under museum guidance.

cards.title: Talk Through the Helm Gallery
cards.subtitle: Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.notes: Take a no-rush gallery lap with friends, stop at one artwork that suggests prairie or people, and share a short interpretation.
cards.short_summary: A named Beach Museum collection gallery with free access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach Museum identifies the John F. Helm Gallery as a collection gallery and states admission and parking are always free.
cards.source_title: Beach Update | Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Located at the Beach Museum, 701 Beach Lane; check bags and large backpacks at the gallery-attendant desk.

cards.title: Hike the Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Konza Prairie Biological Station, near Manhattan
cards.notes: Plan a daylight group hike with water and closed-toe shoes, stay on the marked trail, and leave enough time to return before closing.
cards.short_summary: A 2.6-mile public tallgrass-prairie hike supported by voluntary contributions.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State says Konza’s Nature Trail is open to the public from dawn to dusk and that its maintenance depends on voluntary user contributions, with a $2 contribution appreciated.
cards.source_title: Visit Konza Prairie | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk, weather permitting; no dogs or bikes. The $2 contribution is appreciated, not required.

cards.title: Take the Kings Creek Loop
cards.subtitle: Konza Prairie Biological Station, near Manhattan
cards.notes: Choose this longer daylight route only with a prepared group, keep to designated trails, and check for weather or prescribed-burn closures first.
cards.short_summary: A 4.6-mile public prairie loop where the suggested contribution is voluntary.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State lists the Kings Creek Loop as a 4.6-mile Konza public trail, open dawn to dusk, with a $2 contribution appreciated for trail maintenance.
cards.source_title: Visit Konza Prairie | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk, weather permitting; no dogs or bikes. The $2 contribution is appreciated, not required.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Kansas State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through campus landmarks, culture, study space, recreation, and a local K-State food stop.

cards.title: Start with the campus clocktower
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Anderson Hall
cards.notes: Begin outside the 1879 hall and look up at its tower. Use this recognizable landmark to orient yourself before walking toward the Union.
cards.short_summary: A historic starting point with a bell-filled tower.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State identifies Anderson Hall as a campus building constructed in 1879; its tower contains a 98-bell electronically operated carillon.
cards.source_title: Anderson Hall | K-State campus map
cards.access_notes: Plan this as an exterior landmark stop; building access may vary.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · K-State Student Union
cards.notes: Walk through the Union, locate the ID Center and Student Programs and Involvement, then save the floor map for later campus errands.
cards.short_summary: A central stop for services, organizations, dining, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The K-State Student Union’s official building map lists the ID Center, Student Programs and Involvement, dining, bowling, and other services.
cards.source_title: 2026 Building Maps | K-State Student Union
cards.access_notes: Services and venues are inside the Union; check individual operations for availability.

cards.title: Choose a campus-made dairy treat
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Call Hall Dairy Bar
cards.notes: Stop at the Dairy Bar for ice cream or another listed dairy product, and check the official page before going because hours differ in breaks.
cards.short_summary: A purchase stop connected to K-State’s dairy operations.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State states that the Call Hall Dairy Bar sells ice cream and other dairy products and publishes school-year and break hours.
cards.source_title: Call Hall Dairy Bar | K-State Animal Sciences and Industry
cards.access_notes: The official page lists school-year hours of 9 a.m.–6 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday; confirm seasonal changes.

cards.title: Find a quiet seat in the Great Room
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Hale Library
cards.notes: Use the third-floor Great Room for individual reading or planning. Keep conversation low and phones on vibrate in this designated quiet area.
cards.short_summary: A historic reading room set aside for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Libraries identifies the Great Room on Hale Library’s third floor as a designated quiet study area with abundant study space.
cards.source_title: Study spaces | K-State Libraries
cards.access_notes: Building access follows current Hale Library hours; observe quiet-study expectations.

cards.entity_name: The Gardens at Kansas State University
cards.title: Take an evening garden loop
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 1500 Denison Ave.
cards.notes: Walk the display gardens and pause at the changing plant collections. Choose the daylight portion of the loop and stay on public paths.
cards.short_summary: A horticultural display garden used as a learning laboratory.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State describes the Gardens as a horticultural display garden and learning laboratory for students and the visiting public; admission and parking are free.
cards.source_title: The Gardens | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Open daily, dawn to 10 p.m., according to the Gardens’ official page.

cards.entity_name: Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.title: See regional art at the Beach Museum
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 701 Beach Lane
cards.notes: Visit the galleries, then ask the gallery attendant about photography guidance. Personal, non-commercial photos are permitted without flash.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with regional and broader collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach Museum’s official visitor page states that admission and parking are free and permits personal, non-commercial photography without flash.
cards.source_title: Visit | Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Tue/Wed/Fri 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Thu 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Sat 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sun/Mon and holidays.

cards.title: Walk the World War I memorial stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Memorial Stadium
cards.notes: Approach the stadium as a memorial landmark and read its significance. Avoid practice areas and use public routes around the structure.
cards.short_summary: A 1920s campus memorial that now supports student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State states that Memorial Stadium was dedicated in 1929 to honor students and alumni who died in World War I and is now used for band practice, club soccer, and rugby.
cards.source_title: World War I Memorials | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Use public exterior routes; field and interior access depend on scheduled activities.

cards.title: Spot the MLK memorial outside Ahearn
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Ahearn Field House
cards.notes: Find the Martin Luther King Jr. memorial bust outside Ahearn, then take in the building’s distinctive field-house exterior from the public walkway.
cards.short_summary: A historic athletics building with a commemorative outdoor bust.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State reports that Martin Luther King Jr. gave his final university speech at Ahearn Field House in 1968 and that a memorial bust was installed outside in 2007.
cards.source_title: Ahearn Field House | K-State campus map
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an exterior landmark stop; facility access varies with athletics and events.

cards.title: Check out the Rec Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 1831 Olympic Dr.
cards.notes: Tour the public-facing complex with a friend and ask the desk about current eligibility and entry rules before planning a workout or court time.
cards.short_summary: A large campus recreation facility with courts, tracks, climbing, and fitness areas.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Recreational Services lists courts, climbing and bouldering areas, indoor tracks, fitness areas, and accessible features at the Peters Recreation Complex.
cards.source_title: Peters Recreation Complex | K-State Recreational Services
cards.access_notes: Entry eligibility, guest access, and activity availability are not specified on this facility overview; verify with Recreational Services.

cards.title: End with a look at McCain’s calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 1501 Goldstein Circle
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar and choose an age-appropriate future program. Confirm ticketing and event details directly before making plans.
cards.short_summary: K-State’s live-performing-arts venue and Music Department home.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State identifies McCain Auditorium as the campus cultural center for live performing arts and notes that it serves students and the general public.
cards.source_title: About McCain Auditorium | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Individual performances can have separate ticketing and schedules; consult the official event listing before attending.
